description: Modbus RTU interface module for Samsung DVM air conditioning (up to 48 indoor units and 1 outdoor unit): on/off, mode, fan, set and room temperature, error codes, hot water and ventilation
source: Samsung Modbus Interface Module MIM-B19N / MIM-B19NT Installation manual

sources.title: Modbus Interface Module MIM-B19N / MIM-B19NT Installation manual
sources.version: Table 2 (Modbus register table) and Adding New Modbus Register
sources.note: PDF supplied by the repository owner; no public URL recorded

notes: Modbus RTU slave on RS-485 (2 wires, max 1000 m), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit; big endian. Address 1 to 247 set with the DIP switches (SW4-1 = 128, SW4-2 = 64, SW5-1 = 32, SW5-2 = 16) plus the rotary switch SW1 (0 to 15); reset the module after changing it.

Functions 03 and 04 read, 06 and 16 write. At start-up all registers are 0; wait until communication bit 0 of the status register is set. Wait at least 10 ms between consecutive requests. Writing any holding register sends a control command to the unit, so only write when a change is intended.

Registers 0 to 3 belong to the module and outdoor unit. Each indoor unit (address 0 to 47) has 32 registers at 50 + N*50 + offset; only indoor unit 0 (addresses 50 to 81) is listed here, add N*50 for the others. Which registers apply depends on the unit type (indoor, HE/HT/EHS, AHU kit, ERV, ERV+, chiller, FCU, FCU kit); the manual's table marks them per type.

Further functions can be added by writing MessageSet IDs with function 16: outdoor functions from address 6000 (they appear at address 4 onward), indoor functions from address 7000 (they appear at 50 + N*50 + 32 onward). Those are not described here.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Modbus interface module error status
registers.description: Bit 0 address error, bit 1 communication error on R1/R2, bit 2 tracking error.

registers.name: Integrated outdoor unit error code
registers.description: 0 no error; 100 to 999 error code.

registers.name: Outdoor defrost operation
registers.description: 0 or 0xFF defrost off; other values defrost on.

registers.name: Buzzer on/off
registers.description: 0 turns the buzzer on, 1 turns it off.

registers.name: Communication status (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Bit 0 exist (0 = unit not connected), bit 1 type OK, bit 2 ready, bit 3 communication error. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 0.

registers.name: Unit type (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Low byte: model code (AHU 90-99, ERV 100-102, ERV+ 108, HE 110, HT 120, EHS 115-117, chiller module 140-149, FCU kit 160-169, others IU); high byte: model group (FCU 10, others ignored). Unit type examples (hex): not defined 0xFFFF, HE xx6E, HT xx78, EHS xx73 to xx75, AHU xx5A to xx63, ERV xx64 to xx65, ERV+ xx6C, chiller xx8C to xx95, FCU 0Axx, FCU kit xxA0 to xxA9. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 1.

registers.name: Air conditioner on/off (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 off, 1 on; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 2.

registers.name: Air conditioner mode (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Others ignored. 21 and 24 are for DVM CHILLER only. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 3.

registers.name: Indoor fan speed (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 4.

registers.name: Vertical air flow direction (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 off, 1 on (use of vertical air flow direction). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 5.

registers.name: Filter-cleaning reminder (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 filter alarm not present, 1 filter alarm present. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 6.

registers.name: Cancel filter-cleaning reminder (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 no clear, 1 clear the filter alarm. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 7.

registers.name: Set temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10 (-41 to 100 °C). Cooling 18 to 30 °C, heating 16 to 30 °C; Nordic models can be controlled at 8 to 30 °C for heating. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 8.

registers.name: Room temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10 (-41 to 100 °C). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 9.

registers.name: Discharge temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 10.

registers.name: Cooling discharge set temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10; 8 to 18 °C (AHU: 8 to 25 °C). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 11.

registers.name: Heating discharge set temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10; 30 to 43 °C (AHU: 18 to 43 °C). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 12.

registers.name: Integrated indoor unit error code (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 no error; 100 to 999 error code. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 13.

registers.name: Restrictions on the remote control (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Read: 0x0000 no restriction, others restriction. Write: 0x0000 no restriction, 0x6363 restriction. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 14.

registers.name: Water-in temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10 (HE/HT/EHS and chiller). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 15.

registers.name: Water-out temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10 (HE/HT/EHS and chiller). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 16.

registers.name: MCC water-out temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10 (chiller). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 17.

registers.name: Water-out set temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10. HE: cool 5 to 25 °C, heat 15 to 50 °C. HT: heat 25 to 80 °C (no cooling mode in Hydro HT). EHS: cool 5 to 25 °C, heat 15 to 65 °C. Chiller: heat/heat storage 25 to 55 °C, cool/cool storage -10 to 25 °C. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 18.

registers.name: Ventilation on/off (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 off, 1 on; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 19.

registers.name: Ventilation mode (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 bypass, 1 HeatEx, 2 auto, 6 sleep; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 20.

registers.name: Ventilation fan speed (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 auto, 2 low, 3 high, 4 turbo; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 21.

registers.name: Hot water operation on/off (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 hot water off, 1 hot water on; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 22.

registers.name: Hot water mode (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 eco, 1 standard, 2 power, 3 force (EHS only); others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 23.

registers.name: Hot water set temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10. HE 30 to 75 °C, HT 35 to 75 °C, EHS 30 to 70 °C. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 24.

registers.name: Hot water temperature (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Celsius x10. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 25.

registers.name: Error information collected by MCC (bits) (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Error information of slave chiller units: each bit indicates the unit number where an error occurred (byte 0: units 0 to 7, byte 1: units 8 to 15). Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 26.

registers.name: Error information collected by MCC (code) (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Error code of the lowest-numbered unit with an error (same range as error code index 0202). E.g. unit #2 with error code 201: 00 05 00 C9 hex. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 27.

registers.name: Quiet control (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 silence off, 1 silence on; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 28.

registers.name: Away function (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 outing off, 1 outing on; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 29.

registers.name: Wind-Free function (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: 0 none, 9 WindFree; others ignored. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 30.

registers.name: 360 air flow direction (indoor unit 0)
registers.description: Spot 106, mid 85, wide 64, swing 15; others individual control. Address of indoor unit N = 50 + N*50 + 31.
